scope: Theorem 7.2 (A uniform denominator for the moduli divisor) of the manuscript “Uniform log Iitaka fibrations and bounded moduli denominators” (preprints/Uniform-log-Iitaka-fibrations-and-bounded-moduli-denominators-October-4-2026/uniform-log-iitaka.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fee79cbeaa3ae4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix d ≥ 1 and a finite set Φ ⊂ [0, 1] ∩ Q, and let p0 = p0(d, Φ) be as in Proposition 7.1. There is a positive integer p = p(d, Φ) divisible by p0 with the following property. Let f : X → Z be a contraction of normal projective complex varieties with dim X ≤ d and dim Z > 0, and let (X, B) be lc with B ≥ 0, coefficients in Φ, and KX + B Q-Cartier. For any exact presentation KX + B + 1 p0 div(ψ) = f∗ DZ with ψ ∈ C(X)∗ and DZ Q-Cartier, let M be its moduli b-divisor. On every smooth projective determination W of M, the divisor pMW is nef Cartier.
